summary_en: This note presents several calculus-style limit problems to illustrate asymptotic analysis with Landau symbols, especially how to control accumulated errors using Taylor expansions. It also emphasizes converting products to sums via logarithms and using little-o / big-O notation as a problem-solving framework.

problems.statement_en: Let $$A_N:=\prod_{n\leq N}\frac{n}{n+a},$$ where \(a\) is a fixed real number. Find $$\lim_{N\to\infty} A_N.$$
problems.statement_zh: 令$$A_N:=\prod_{n\leq N}\frac{n}{n+a}$$其中$a$是一个固定的实数，求$$\lim_{n\to \infty }A_N$$
key_techniques: logarithm to convert a product into a sum

key_techniques_discussed: converting products to sums via logarithms
using logarithms to study exponential-type limits
